title: Stick force per g -- normal and accelerated turning
objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of manoeuvring stability, normally measured as stick force per “g” conforms to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 1.3 daN (3 lbs) or ± 10% stick force | ± 1.5 cm (0.6 in) or ± 10% column position | ± 0.1 g normal acceleration
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
